explanation: This fires only at GO steps and stays 0 at every D1 and D2 step: it builds up over a run of unrewarded trials in the first half of the episode (about trials 3-50). At GO it is usually 0, climbs to about 4-9 at the 2nd-3rd GO in a row with no reward (often while still choosing a1), sits at 10 at GO while the agent has switched to a2 and losses continue, then drops back to 0 at the first GO after a rewarded trial, and stays near 0 after trial 60 even during losing runs.
